comparison.objective: Zip an already-started jacket to the collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin flexible fabric while pulling and potentially regrasping a zipper slider.
comparison.success_condition: Progress equals remaining travel closed; full credit within 3 mm of top with both hands >40 mm clear, while pin protrusion >3 mm zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable stabilization and guided slider travel, not rigid-body sifting.
